//// Four slashes make a plain comment.
fn four() {}

/**/
fn empty_block() {}

/*** Three asterisks make a plain comment. */
fn three() {}

///
/// A doc comment with blank lines at its edges.
///
fn edges() {}

///
/// ```
/// let x = 1; // inside a fence

fn fenced() {}
